title: Tutor Learner Awareness and Adaptive Tutoring Engine
description: Transform the tutor from context-aware to learner-aware by injecting LearnerSnapshot data and learning recommendations into the TutorNode system prompt. Adds a LearnerProfileBuilder module that computes difficulty level, detects active misconceptions, and formats the ## Learner Profile block.

userStories.title: Learner Profile Builder module
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a standalone module that takes a LearnerSnapshot and current topic, computes the tutoring difficulty level, detects relevant misconceptions, and produces a formatted ## Learner Profile system prompt block.
acceptanceCriteria: LearnerProfileBuilder class at src/core/learning_intelligence/tutor/learner_profile_builder.py with build_profile(snapshot, current_topic) -> BuildProfileResult

4 difficulty levels: BEGINNER (critical mastery OR confidence<0.3 OR ability<-1.0), DEVELOPING (moderate mastery OR confidence 0.3-0.6 OR ability -1.0-0.0), PROFICIENT (no weak topics AND confidence>=0.6 AND all abilities>=0.0), ADVANCED (no weak topics AND confidence>0.9 AND all abilities>1.0)
profile_block contains ## Learner Profile section with weak_topics, strong_topics, difficulty_level, confidence, ability estimates
If current_topic matches a snapshot misconception with frequency >= 2, adds ## Known Misconception subsection to profile_block
userStories.notes: Conservative teach-to-weakest thresholds. Snapshot data via EducationalMemorySummary.confidence and per-topic mastery/ability.

userStories.title: TutorNode integration with Learner Profile
userStories.description: As a learner, I want the tutor to be aware of my educational state — weak topics, misconceptions, difficulty level — and adapt its explanations accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: TutorNode.__init__ accepts optional snapshot_service and recommendation_service parameters
In __call__, if state.user_id is set: fetch LearnerSnapshot via SnapshotService and recommendations via RecommendationService
Call LearnerProfileBuilder.build_profile(snapshot, state.topic) to get the profile block
Inject ## Learner Profile block into system prompt between memory context and hint/reveal prompts
If user_id is not set (e.g., anonymous chat), skip snapshot/recommendation fetch and maintain existing behavior
TutorNode creates its own AsyncSession internally via async_session_factory() when user_id is set — no session parameter needed in __init__ or __call__
userStories.notes: SnapshotService and RecommendationService already have 5-min Redis cache, so per-call overhead is ~50ms on cache hit.
